entries.title: Task rows no longer name the computer or the project, so titles get the whole row
entries.body: A row in the Tasks panel now shows its key and title, and a task's parts count where it has parts. It no longer ends with the project's name or which computer runs the task; the key still says the project, and resting on the row names both. Only when a task's computer cannot take work does the row still say why, such as out of reach. A parts count also no longer draws over the row's words. The phone's Tasks list matches.

picture.alt: The Tasks panel's Working rows, each showing only its key and full title, with a parts count on the first row
